title: Y-DNA haplogroup tree (YFull YTree)
description: The human Y-chromosome phylogeny: which SNPs define each paternal-line haplogroup, placed on GRCh37 and cut down to SNPs consumer chips probe. Used to find the deepest haplogroup the chip's Y calls support.
